alt: A detailed sculpture features a bald eagle, bear, wolf, and bobcat perched atop a turtle on a rock base adorned with Native American-style dreamcatchers, beads, and stones.
A close-up of a sculpted bald eagle head with detailed white feathers and a yellow beak, positioned above a dark bear head against a soft blue background.
A detailed figurine features a wolf head and an owl emerging from a tree stump, which sits atop a turtle on a rocky base adorned with beads, feathers, and small animal figures.
A detailed sculpture of a lynx with green eyes and a tortoise shell body, topped with a wooden structure featuring a wolf's head.
A smiling woman with dark hair stands beside a detailed, multi-animal sculpture featuring a turtle, bobcat, bear, wolf, and eagle, while holding a blue winner's ribbon and a certificate.
A detailed sculpture features a gray wolf head with yellow eyes and a white eagle perched atop, alongside a small owl nestled in the textured, wood-like base, adorned with a beaded necklace.

A surreal sculpture features a white wolf head emerging from the left side of a gnarled, tree-like structure, while an owl with intense yellow eyes peers out from a central hollow, adorned with hanging beaded necklaces and a silver pendant.
A detailed sculpture depicts a bald eagle, black bear, wolf, and bobcat stacked atop a tortoise on a rocky base adorned with Native American-style dreamcatchers, feathers, and beads.
A detailed figurine depicts a lynx with green eyes perched atop a star-patterned turtle, both resting on a rocky base adorned with feathers, beads, and small stones.

A beaded dreamcatcher with a red, white, and blue geometric pattern hangs from a brown cord against a sculpted gray rock backdrop, surrounded by colorful polished stones, feathers, and a textured animal claw.
A detailed clay diorama depicts a rocky landscape adorned with a miniature dreamcatcher, a patterned woven bag, scattered gemstones, and the scaled legs of a dragon perched above.
A detailed sculpture featuring a white-headed eagle with a yellow beak perched above a bear and a wolf, all rendered in textured material against a muted blue-gray background.
A detailed sculpture of a bear's head adorned with a beaded necklace and an eagle's head, emerging from a textured, wood-like base with a wolf's head on the side.
A sculpted totem pole features a bald eagle, wolf, bear, and bobcat stacked atop a turtle, all resting on a rocky base adorned with a dreamcatcher, beads, and feathers.
A detailed figurine of a radiated tortoise with a black and yellow patterned shell stands on a rocky base adorned with colorful stones, a feather, and a beaded cord.
